constraint local_checks.ck_local_checks_: CHECK ((((check_type = 'TITLE_EXISTS'::text) AND (result = 'PASS'::text) AND (reason_code = 'TITLE_FOUND'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'TITLE_EXISTS'::text) AND (result = 'UNKNOWN'::text) AND (reason_code = 'TITLE_PENDING_WINDOW'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'TITLE_EXISTS'::text) AND (result = 'FAIL'::text) AND (reason_code = 'NO_TITLE_RECORD'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'LIENHOLDER_MATCH'::text) AND (result = 'PASS'::text) AND (reason_code = 'LIENHOLDER_MATCHES'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'LIENHOLDER_MATCH'::text) AND (result = 'FAIL'::text) AND (reason_code = 'LIENHOLDER_MISMATCH'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'LIENHOLDER_MATCH'::text) AND (result = 'UNKNOWN'::text) AND (reason_code = 'TITLE_PENDING_WINDOW'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'LIENHOLDER_MATCH'::text) AND (result = 'UNKNOWN'::text) AND (reason_code = 'NO_TITLE_RECORD'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'PAYMENTS_RECEIVED'::text) AND (result = 'UNKNOWN'::text) AND (reason_code = 'FIRST_PAYMENT_NOT_DUE'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'PAYMENTS_RECEIVED'::text) AND (result = 'PASS'::text) AND (reason_code = 'PAYMENT_IN_WINDOW'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'PAYMENTS_RECEIVED'::text) AND (result = 'FAIL'::text) AND (reason_code = 'NO_PAYMENT_IN_WINDOW'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'CONTRACT_PRESENT'::text) AND (result = 'FAIL'::text) AND (reason_code = 'NO_CONTRACT_RECORD'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'CONTRACT_PRESENT'::text) AND (result = 'FAIL'::text) AND (reason_code = 'CONTRACT_LENDER_MISMATCH'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'CONTRACT_PRESENT'::text) AND (result = 'FAIL'::text) AND (reason_code = 'CONTRACT_TERMS_MISMATCH'::text)) OR ((check_type = 'CONTRACT_PRESENT'::text) AND (result = 'PASS'::text) AND (reason_code = 'CONTRACT_MATCHES'::text))))
